steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Guh... Urgh...

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: I really... don't have anything here.

steps.name: Starving Thug
steps.text: Bollocks! We saw it with our own eyes. You used your stove. Where did you get food?

steps.name: Starving Thug
steps.text: How come you have something to eat every day?!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: I... I just found it by chance...

steps.name: Starving Thug
steps.text: Found it?

steps.name: Calm Thug
steps.text: Don't go overboard with him. If this guy gets an Oripathy attack, we'll all be dead.

steps.name: Starving Thug
steps.text: Where's your storeroom? Spill it!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: I really... Just found them... Someone has been leaving things on my windowsill...

steps.name: Starving Thug
steps.text: Still trying to hide—
Are his words really so untrustworthy?
Even the Infected get lucky sometimes and find food, right? What's so strange about that?

steps.name: Starving Thug
steps.text: And who are you? Here to rob him, too?
Hello. My name is Red.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Back in my Ursus days, they all called me 'Redblade.'

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Pick up the pace. Stay close.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Hang in there! We're almost there!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Drat! There's more and more of them.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: White Wolf, I've heard about you and your family.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: I'm glad to have the opportunity to fight alongside you today.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: For Londinium, and for Victoria.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What are you trying to—

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Don't stop! Keep moving!

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: Sarkaz traitor and Victorian insects, it's high time we brought an end to this game of hide-and-seek.

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: Where do you want to run? Is it death that you want to escape?

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: You and your friends who are hiding in the shadows will all be torn to shreds. It's what you owe us!

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: This is what everyone in Londinium, Victoria, and across the lands owe us!

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: Run. Run! The storm will still arrive. You can't outrun war!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Shut your bloody gob!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (Gah, too many people. We need to find a way to break through here!)

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (I only have one grenade left...)

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Robben, take this grenade. Head down, and blow up the bottom deck of power layer.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Misery, protect them. The rest of you need to keep moving forward.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Got it. Don't worry.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We'll leave the rest to luck.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn... You—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Shut up. I don't have time to pummel you again.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Hurry!
Horn turns around and faces a wave of enemies surging on her position.
She smirks a little. It is high time this all came to an end.
All this fleeing, the battles, and these sleepless nights.
Soldiers are meant to die in war.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I wonder... what Bagpipe is up to right now.
She tightens her grip on her weapon and prepares to charge.
Under the dark, cloudy sky, a strange sound can be heard zooming in ever closer from afar.
A familiar sound, although it has been a long time since it was last heard in Londinium.
It is only in their distant memories and fuzzy rumors that people can find that sound's source—

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: That's—

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Horn, run! Take this chance!

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: 'The Last Steam Knight'
steps.text: (Heavy gushing)

steps.name: 'The Last Steam Knight'
steps.text: 'Victoria.'

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Drat, these doors—

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: They're too thick. They can't hear us on the other side!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Grr, they took Clovisia and Catherine. Are they trying to use them as bargaining chips with the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: These despicable traitors—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Shining, can you open them?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We can't delay any longer. We don't know when the Sarkaz will make it here.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I will give it a try.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No! Don't! Don't make a big show like that! That's only going to draw the enemy here faster!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We have a bunch of critically wounded and non-combatants here. If we actually start fighting the Royal Court guys, even if we can get away, what about them?

spans.text: We have a bunch of critically wounded and non-combatants here. If we actually start fighting the Royal Court guys, even if
can get away, what about them?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We'd only be waiting to meet our maker by remaining here. I don't know what my friends are scheming, but my guys is they have more in mind than keeping us here.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: My drone has a small laser cutting device. These steel plates may be thick, but if you give me some time...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: How long will it take?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, keep your pants on! I need to test the output first...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Feist, do you remember what happened to Old Bill?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: It has to be... One of those monsters has got to have infiltrated us again. He fooled us again!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: We were too careless. We should've noticed sooner!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Feist... Are those Sarkaz who can change their faces here too?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: When those things exist, how... how can we trust anyone?

spans.text: exist, how... how can we trust anyone?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What if... that's not what this is?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: They're our allies! They're Londinium workers, too!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I know. I grew up with them.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But what if...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What if this is their decision. This is the choice that Tommy, Patto, and Day made with everybody else?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: But why...? We're supposed to be on the same side!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It's easier to believe that your allies were replaced than to accept that they've betrayed us.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But that's exactly what happened.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I can tell what they were thinking, more or less. Once the rage-induced fervor dissipates, it's not so easy to choose to keep fighting.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Clovisia said as much before too. In the end, we're just a bunch of normal people.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I have to admit that... even I fear leaving, just like them.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Fleeing and cowering... is the most instinctive choice that all normal people make when they are confronted with war.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Then you stay! Stay here with your friends!

spans.text: stay! Stay here with your friends!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I won't do that, Rockrock.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I have to face my fear. That's the only way I can remind myself... of the worth of bravery.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I have faith that they haven't crossed that line. I have faith that they were only sucked into this choice by fear.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But none of it matters now.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I will save Granny and Clovisia, just like I did last time.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But our wounded can't wait much longer.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The drone's laser's working on the door already! It'll take... uh, twenty minutes, maybe?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I'll help, too. I have tools on me!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Your hammer and wrench aren't gonna come in handy here.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Be patient. Just hold on a little longer, and we can leave this place safe and...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wh-What? I didn't catch any Sarkaz movement!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Shining—
Oh, hey, Shining. Been a while. I heard you went to a family reunion?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: W, you're here.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: W! Half of Londinium heard that just now!

steps.name: W
steps.text: The curtain's drawn, right? I've always been pretty accurate with my explosives. Just the right amount.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I heard Kal'tsit got beat up real bad, so I thought I'd find some time to come take a look.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Whoa, she did really did take a beating. Theresis doesn't know how to hold back, huh?

steps.name: W
steps.text: And here I thought the guy would go gentler on his 'old friend.'

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: She's still unconscious.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Well, shit, that's too bad. For me, that is. Should I shed a few tears for her?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Or maybe I oughta take this chance to make sure the old hag never crosses me again?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Muffled braying)

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ugh, that little shit's not dead either?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Menacing growl)

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hmph, still so nasty.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Mon3tr was very heavily damaged. It wasn't until two hours ago that it recovered its motor functions. I suggest you avoid provoking it.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm saving its master's life. At the very least, it's gotta learn to treat me with a bit more respect.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Otherwise, hehe—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Compromising low roar)

steps.name: W
steps.text: Now that's more like it.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The Royal Court fighters are heading this way! Quick, we gotta get out of here before they...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, quit your yapping, Closure. It hurts my ears.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Whose fault do you think that is?!

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you're so worried, get your men to move double time already.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I know a couple good spots outside the city. Wanna take a look?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: With the supplies we have on hand, best-case scenario, we should be able to last another week.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: What about worst-case scenario?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Alright, I get it.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Cador and I will keep trying to come up with something.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: What is the situation like outside?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: A borough that normally has less than ten thousand residents suddenly finds its population surging multiple times over. No additional supplies. No police. No law and order.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: We're still alive even after the last several days. We should be thankful that the citizens still have a shred of morality.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It could also be because Cador's fists pack a punch.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I don't deny that.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Have you heard anything about what the dukes' plans are? I heard... Duke Windermere's barracks aren't far from here.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I'm sure... they won't turn a blind eye to our predicament.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I've heard rumors... Some have said they saw a blaze surge through the night sky.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: We all saw that flying thing the Sarkaz had... On the day we were cast out of Londinium, its shadow swept through the entire plate.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: My guess is that the dukes are all very fearful of that, and they're only probing how to attack it right now.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Of course, it's also possible that the outside world has gone to hell, and Londinium has been bombed to smithereens. Who knows?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Maybe the dukes don't know that there are still people alive here?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Maybe... they thought all of us... died.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: If only we had a way to get word out...

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: What way? The intercity net is completely paralyzed.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Hapless sods trapped in the lockdown zone like us should just worry about whether we'll have anything to eat tomorrow.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It's hard to believe that just a few days ago, we were still watching that awful Wrankwood movie in the video shop.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: What was that movie called again? War of the Mutant Geeks?

spans.text: What was that movie called again?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: The ending was actually pretty touching, though.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I wouldn't know. I fell asleep. All I saw was the nomadic city getting blown up in the explosion at the very end.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: All I remember is that Mr. McClaren was awfully generous with his money. After all, we helped him deal with the video shop's troubles plenty of times.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I only hope that he is doing well. The situation outside wouldn't do his neurasthenia any favors.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I stopped by the video shop for a look. His door was sealed shut.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Why did you always sleep in the video shop, though? I remember we met each other because...

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Because your laughter woke me up.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Sorry, but that movie was really funny.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: But to start, it was your fault for falling asleep there.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: There is no better place to sleep than there.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: That comedy director is really famous. I have all her—
An untimely growl that signifies hunger can suddenly be heard, shattering the easygoing atmosphere that the two finally managed to build.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: You've been eating too little. Your stamina won't last if you keep this up.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It's okay. We need to carry on.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: The lives we had came to an end just like that. In an instant, this is what it all turned into.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: There are lunatics and dead bodies everywhere. There are the blockade walls that the Sarkaz built... There have been men attempting to break through them the past couple days. Their brains are still hanging on the walls.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I still don't understand. How did it—

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: War has broken out, Baird.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I know. I know! But just because of those few weightless words...

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Everyone's past disappeared without a trace in the blink of an eye.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Whose war is this?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: The dukes are trying to protect Victoria...

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: All I know is that this war is not mine.
A small, broken stir as well as the clanging of multiple cans can be heard from the shadows.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: It isn't your turn to stand watch tonight.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: What's that you're hiding underneath your coat?

steps.name: Timid Citizen
steps.text: S-Stay back!
